mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing fair conditions near Verona Area High School.

The City of Verona has announced that city buildings will be closed on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27, in observance of Thanksgiving. Please note that refuse and recycling pickup for Thursday will be delayed until Friday, November 27, and the recycling center will be closed those two days as well.

We have a busy schedule starting with live music today at Bailey's Run, followed by music at Lake Lou-ee tomorrow. Looking ahead, Tuesday brings a variety of trivia events at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus pizza specials and more music.

In our weekly police report, we look back to November 2, when officers were dispatched to West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, which resulted in a 48-year-old local man being arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.

Today was all about that OREO Cookie Overload, but since the Culver's of Verona is now closed for the night, please keep in mind that the store opens tomorrow at 10:00 AM with the featured flavor, Butter Pecan.
